data.name: Power Crawler
data.description: A 5-day dumbbell-focused strength and hypertrophy program designed to build powerful upper and lower body development. The routine combines heavy low-rep pressing and rowing with targeted exercises for the chest, shoulders, back, arms, legs, and core. With a mix of compound movements and isolation work, it emphasizes strength, muscle development, and functional athletic power.

data.name: 🏛️ THE OLYMPIAN — Greek God Physique
data.description: A 6-day Greek God-inspired physique program built around the classic aesthetic: broad shoulders, wide back, full chest, strong arms, powerful legs, and a tight athletic core.The routine combines compound strength movements, hypertrophy work, bodyweight exercises, and athletic conditioning. The emphasis on pull-ups, rows, presses, lateral raises, squats, and core training is designed to create a V-taper and balanced muscular proportions rather than simply maximizing size.

data.name: Thor's Workout
data.description: Godlike physique. his routine is designed primarily for muscle hypertrophy and strength, while Day 6 adds conditioning and athletic fitness. It is a demanding program because of its high training volume and six consecutive training days.
